title: GTA 6 made more in ONE day than most movies ever do #gta6 #shorts
description:
One day. $3.79 billion. Rockstar says GTA 6 had the biggest launch day in entertainment history, and that's before counting the 39 million people who jumped in on PlayStation in the first four days.

Numbers from Take-Two/Rockstar (via AP) and the PlayStation Blog.

scenes.say: GTA 6 made three point seven nine billion dollars in a single day.

scenes.label: day-one sales
scenes.say: Rockstar says that's the biggest launch day for anything in entertainment, ever.

scenes.label: copies sold before launch
scenes.say: Thirty two and a half million copies were sold before the game even unlocked.

scenes.label: players on PlayStation
scenes.say: And thirty nine million people played it on PlayStation in just four days.
Turns out thirteen years of waiting builds up a little demand.
So, have you played it yet?
